name: Leverage Iso Row (Neutral Grip - Lats)
instructions: Adjust the seat height so the chest pad supports your sternum and the vertical handles align with your lower chest level.
Grasp the vertical handles using a neutral grip with palms facing each other.
Keep your chest pinned firmly against the pad and pull the handles toward your hips, keeping your elbows tucked close to your ribs.
Squeeze your lats hard at peak contraction without leaning back off the pad.
Slowly extend your arms back to the starting position for a full lat stretch before initiating the next repetition.
